name: Alibi
howItWorks: Two "suspects" leave and agree a story; the class questions them separately (Where were you at 7? Who were you with?) and hunts for differences

name: Baamboozle / Wordwall quiz
howItWorks: Team quiz on the projector; teams must answer in a full sentence to score
prep: Find a ready game by module name

name: Balloon debate
howItWorks: Each student is a famous person or invention in a sinking balloon and argues why they should stay

name: Birthday line-up
howItWorks: Class lines up by birthday, asking only in English: When's your birthday?

name: Board race
howItWorks: Two teams, one pen each; you call a category, runners write words; the team must say them aloud to score

name: Buzz
howItWorks: Count round the class; say "buzz" instead of multiples of 5 (or 3); a mistake means sit down

name: Chain story
howItWorks: Each student adds one sentence to a story, using the target tense

name: Charades
howItWorks: Mime a word or action; the team guesses with the target phrase (You're swimming!)

name: Class survey
howItWorks: Everyone asks five classmates one question, then reports: Three people like pizza.

name: Colour hunt / Touch something…
howItWorks: Call "Touch something red!"; children run and touch it and say "red"

name: Debate (four corners)
howItWorks: Corners marked Agree, Disagree, Not sure, It depends; students move and justify

name: Describe and draw
howItWorks: One partner describes a hidden picture; the other draws it; then compare

name: Detective
howItWorks: Cards show where each person was; students ask Were you at…? to solve who took the cake

name: Diamond ranking
howItWorks: Groups rank nine problems in a diamond shape and defend the top one

name: Find someone who
howItWorks: Mingle with a grid of prompts; find a classmate for each and write their name

name: Flash and guess
howItWorks: Flash a flashcard for a second; first to name it wins a point

name: Fortune teller
howItWorks: A "fortune teller" predicts classmates' futures with will / going to

name: Freeze dance
howItWorks: Dance to music; when it stops, freeze and name the flashcard you hold up

name: Freeze frame
howItWorks: A group freezes in a scene; the class describes it (They're playing football)

name: Guess who
howItWorks: Describe a classmate or cartoon character; others guess

name: Hide the toy
howItWorks: One child hides a toy; the class guides the seeker with hot / cold or in / on / under

name: Hot potato
howItWorks: Pass a ball to music; whoever holds it when the music stops answers a question

name: Hot seat
howItWorks: One student sits facing the class as a character, animal or famous person; the class interviews them

name: Information gap
howItWorks: Partners hold different halves of the information (timetable, map, fridge) and must ask to complete it

name: Kim's game / What's missing?
howItWorks: Show 6–10 objects, cover them, remove one; the class says what's missing

name: Mingle with role cards
howItWorks: Everyone gets a passport, ID or role card and meets as many people as possible

name: Monster dictation
howItWorks: You describe a monster (three eyes, a big nose); children draw it, then compare

name: Mystery bag
howItWorks: A child feels an object inside a bag and guesses: Is it a ball?

name: Pass the parcel
howItWorks: Layers of paper with a question under each; unwrap when the music stops

name: Role-play (shop, café, vet, hotel)
howItWorks: Set up a counter, price tags or a menu; customers and staff swap roles

name: Shark Tank pitch
howItWorks: Groups invent and pitch a product; "investors" ask questions and vote

name: Simon says
howItWorks: Follow commands only when they start with "Simon says"

name: Slow reveal
howItWorks: Uncover a picture bit by bit on the projector; students guess with Is it a…?

name: Spot the difference
howItWorks: Pairs hold two similar pictures and find differences by describing, not showing

name: Stand up if…
howItWorks: Stand up if you like pizza! Students stand and say "I like pizza"

name: Story dice
howItWorks: Roll picture dice and build a story using each picture

name: Top Trumps
howItWorks: Compare card stats with comparatives: My elephant is heavier!

name: Traffic lights
howItWorks: Red card = stop, green = go, yellow = walk slowly; add words and actions

name: Two truths and a lie
howItWorks: Say three sentences about yourself; the class finds the lie with questions

name: Verb slap
howItWorks: Verbs on the board; two players race to slap the past form you call

name: What's the time, Mr Wolf?
howItWorks: The class asks the time; "Mr Wolf" answers until "Dinner time!" and chases

name: Would you rather
howItWorks: Pick one of two options and say why: I'd rather… because…

name: Yummy or yucky
howItWorks: Show food cards; children rub tummies (yummy) or pull faces (yucky) and say it
